## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this change and which module it affects (e.g., IMM Scoring Engine, Intermittent Auction Desk, Tranche Capital Allocation, Regulatory Observer).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Mathematical model refinement (IMM scoring or stress calibration)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance or styling improvement

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly without errors (`npm run lint` & `npm run build` pass)
- [ ] No regressions in mathematical scoring logic or sensitivity calculations
- [ ] Adheres to the domain design guidelines (Zero-pill metadata, single-line controls, tabular numerals)
- [ ] Updated corresponding documentation (`README.md` or `ARCHITECTURE.md`) if applicable
